
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- pin_999.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- pin_999.volt:4[/red bold]

GPIO 999 does not exist on ESP32.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 999
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Available pins: 0-39 (excluding 20, 24, 28-31)[/cyan]
